rules.text: In tidyvpc use yobs= and ysim= (not y=) in observed() and simulated(). The observed and simulated y columns are often both named DV.
Call plot() on the tidyvpc object returned by vpcstats(), not vpc_plot(). Use tidyvpc_plot_vpc MCP tool to save a PNG and register it in the host report Rmd.
Stratify VPCs with stratify() before binning when covariate-specific predictive checks are required. Confirm column names from the loaded VPC run artifacts.
Every tidyvpc MCP tool records runnable R code into the host reproducible script (certara_repro_script). Plot tools also register figures in the report Rmd (certara_report_rmd).

session_start: tidyvpc builds VPCs from RsNLME VPC simulation output (predcheck0 + predout). Run start_nlme_vpcmodel first, then tidyvpc_load_from_dir or tidyvpc_load_from_rds.
prerequisites: A completed RsNLME VPC job with predcheck0 and predout/simout artifacts, or vpc.rds from collect_nlme_job.
